problem: Public consumers need durable board/task documentary state through sole Hermes authority, not a duplicate database.
existingInsufficient: Echo, records, memory and assurance lack Kanban task and event semantics.
abstraction: One method-specific orchestration/kanban capability with board/get/list/create/update/comment/events; no generic work service.
providers: Independent Kanban backend future candidate only, not required
consumers: Separate public SDK consumer without Hermes or adapter internals
alternatives: No direct SQL/private router/dashboard scraping, no new state service or execution control.
security: Host operation grants and exact trusted caller mapping; isolated backend/no credentials inheritance; payload cannot supply authority; service credential is broad so adapter is trusted enforcement.
scopes: Application/session labels plus exact public board mapping, no implicit ancestry or cross-board lookup.
compatibility: Purely additive; original Catalog/Kernel/ACAP/Foundation unchanged. Weak concurrency and UNKNOWN outcomes explicit.
genericRationale: Kanban task documentary states and bounded event replay without provider filesystem, PID, profile or schema.
